description: Generate a source-escrow deposit bundle for a codebase (source @ pinned commit + generated doc set + obligations manifest + dependency register + handover runbook, one zip). Requires `write` scope. Pass codebaseId or repo ("owner/name"). Returns depositId, commitSha, and a downloadUrl. Generation takes up to a few minutes for large repos.
name: anyforge_generate_escrow_deposit
title: Generate escrow deposit
